findings.current: “Someone had to keep watch on the road. And I didn’t leave you there.”
findings.defect: Taekyung denies throwing Mujin down, not leaving him on the road. The draft makes him deny something he has just admitted doing.
findings.rationale: 안 던졌어 directly denies the physical action of throwing him, setting up the claim that Taekyung put him down carefully.
findings.replacement: “Someone had to keep watch on the road. And I didn’t throw you.”
findings.source: “누구는 길을 지키고 있어야지. 그리고 안 던졌어.”

findings.current: Li Feng, Assistant Military Commissioner of Shanxi Province, was a former Huashan Disciple who’d joined the military through the civil service examinations.
findings.defect: The examination is military, not civil, and 속가제자 specifies a lay disciple.
findings.rationale: 무과 is the military examination; 속가제자 distinguishes a lay disciple from an ordinary disciple.
findings.replacement: Li Feng, Assistant Military Commissioner of Shanxi Province, was a former lay disciple of Huashan who’d joined the military after passing the military service examination.
findings.source: 산서성 도지휘첨사(都指揮僉事)라는 요직을 맡고 있는 이풍은 화산파의 속가제자에서 무과를 통해 군문에 투신한 케이스다.

findings.current: “I’m asking why you left me in the middle of the road while you went somewhere safe to sleep by yourself.”
findings.defect: “Left me” drops Mujin’s accusation that Taekyung threw him down.
findings.rationale: 던져 놓고 names the action Mujin objects to and Taekyung immediately denies.
findings.replacement: “I’m asking why you threw me down in the middle of the road while you went somewhere safe to sleep by yourself.”
findings.source: “아니, 저는 왜 길 한복판에 던져 놓고 혼자서 안전한 곳에서 주무셨냐는 거죠.”

findings.current: “Am I the kind of guy who can sleep with his mouth all crooked?”
findings.defect: Mujin is asking whether Taekyung cares if his mouth goes crooked, not claiming he can sleep that way.
findings.rationale: 상관없는 challenges Taekyung’s unequal concern for their safety.
findings.replacement: “So it doesn’t matter if my mouth goes crooked?”

findings.current: Hyuk Mujin, who’d been looking at me with an expression of mild admiration ever since I praised him, answered quickly.
findings.defect: Admiration changes Mujin’s reaction from being touched by the praise to looking up to Taekyung.
findings.rationale: 살짝 감동한 describes Mujin as mildly moved.
findings.replacement: Hyuk Mujin, who’d been looking at me as though my earlier praise had touched him a little, answered quickly.
findings.source: 앞서 들었던 칭찬 때문인지, 살짝 감동한 표정으로 날 바라보고 있던 혁무진이 잽싸게 대답했다.

findings.defect: “Clop” suggests a hoofbeat where the source gives a person’s approaching footstep.
findings.rationale: 저벅 marks the footfall before the prince’s foot enters Taekyung’s lowered view.

findings.defect: The System notice retains square brackets around a UI term, contrary to the packet’s Markdown rule.
findings.rationale: The framed System panel already identifies the notice; its UI terms should not be enclosed in square brackets.

summary: The draft has a few consequential changes to the road exchange and Li Feng’s background, plus localized characterization and formatting issues.
